paragraphs: Rav Yitzḥak bar Avin, Rosh HaShanah (17a), chapter Asarah Yuḥasin (77a), chapter Merubbeh (76, end of side a), Shevuot (26a), Zevaḥim (42a), Bekhorot (38a). In Rabbah's time (I did not find this). Yuḥasin brings R. Yoḥanan bar Avin (I did not find him); perhaps it is a scribal error. R. Yose bar Avin may be his brother.
